subject: general
question: Which was the first state in India to have a communist government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Following the foremost elections to the **Kerala Legislative Assembly in 1957**, the Communist Party of India come out as the single largest party.
 
• **E M S Namboodiripad** formed the first elected government with the **help of 5 independent legislators**.
 
• **On 26 December 1925**, The Communist Party of India set up the **first Party Conference in Kanpur**, then Cawnpore.
 
• Communist Party of India is a political party in India with a **powerful existence in the states of Kerala**, **West Bengal and Tripura.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Communist government **is **a structure in which goods are possessed in common and are available to all as needed**. 
 
• **Communism **is a** far-left philosophical, social, political, and economic ideology and movement **whose goal is the formation of a communist society.
 
• Communism is **a centralized form of government led by a single party that is **frequently authoritarian **in its rule**.
